title: Portrait with aloe and lace
alt: Painting on linen of a woman in profile. Bare branches grow from her hair, a sunbird flies past, and a farmhouse, a winding road and a flowering aloe rise from her shoulder beside a panel of white lace.

title: Winter candles
alt: Thickly painted aloe in bloom against a violet and apricot dusk sky over dark hills.

title: Two bushbabies
alt: Two wide-eyed bushbabies peeping over the rim of a rusted tin against a dark, speckled background.

title: Kudu bull
alt: Charcoal drawing of a kudu bull with long spiralling horns.

title: Strata
alt: Abstract painting in horizontal bands of red ochre, rust, bone white and charcoal.

title: Portrait with aloe, in graphite
alt: Graphite drawing of a weathered face in close-up beside a flowering aloe.

title: Naartjies in enamel
alt: Still life of oranges and peeled naartjies in a chipped white enamel basin on a rough table.

title: Thorn tree, low sun
alt: Black linocut of a flat-topped thorn tree in front of a coral-red sun.

title: Roller on thorn
alt: Lilac-breasted roller perched on a thorn branch against a loose ochre background.

title: Low water
alt: Loose watercolour of a wide, shallow river with sandbanks, bare trees and ochre hills.

title: Kloof at first light
alt: Palette-knife painting of pink and gold sandstone cliffs above still, misty water at dawn.
